raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

[InferenceX #4315](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4315) needs its MI355X AgentX serving configuration documented in the SGLang cookbook. #45070 aligned §3.6 with [InferenceX #4245](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4245), whose recipe is byte-identical to #4315's; #4315 only moves the image from `-20261016` to `-20261019`. Comparing every effective arm of the #4315 recipe with §3.6 still found server settings that §3.6 has never carried.

## Summary

- Aligns the DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 MI355X AgentX cookbook (§3.6) with SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4315.
- Names the image #4315 pins, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261019`, and links the submitted recipe at `fd09dd949a18`.
- Adds `SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING=1`, `SGLANG_DSV4_REASONING_EFFORT=high` and `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=0` to all three commands, `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2` to the TP8 command and `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=5` to the DP8 command. The MegaMoE command already set `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=5`.
- Adds the sizing rule: `--max-running-requests` at twice the concurrency, `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode` at the same value capped at 128.
- Adds `--dp-aware` to the `cache_aware` router guidance. Without it the router registers one worker per server, so it cannot place a session on the DP rank that holds its prefix.

## Source of truth

- InferenceX PR: https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4315
- InferenceX head reviewed: `fd09dd949a18ef2f3ff2912411d980b3f6b810a1` (rechecked unchanged before opening this PR)
- SGLang main base: `ab580b2e060059c0f8387b598a9f648dcec13f93`
- Sweep/eval run: [run 39258204219](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39258204219). GitHub reports conclusion `success` at `cb80a92c4a4c`, with all nine agentic jobs (c1–c384) and both eval-only jobs (c48, c384) `success` on the `-20261019` image. The recipe file and the `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp` entry are byte-identical between `cb80a92c4a4c` and the head; the head's sweep ([run 39329752188](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39329752188)) reuses it via `/reuse-sweep-run`. I did not rerun any benchmark or eval.

## Coverage

Each row is one server configuration of the effective #4315 recipe (base merged with the point's override):

| #4315 arm | Topology | §3.6 source | Missing on `main` | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| c1, c4 | TP8, breakable prefill graphs | TP8 command + adjustments | sizing, `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=0`, `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2`, thinking defaults | match |
| c16 | TP8 + prefill CP | TP8 command + adjustments | same | match |
| c32, c48 | TP8 + prefill CP + HiCache | TP8 command + HiCache flags | same | match |
| c128 | TP8 + DP8 attention, EP1, HiCache | DP8 command | sizing, `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=0`, `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=5`, thinking defaults, router `--dp-aware` | match |
| c128 | TP8 + DP8 + EP8 MegaMoE, EPLB, HiCache | MegaMoE command | sizing, `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=0`, thinking defaults, router `--dp-aware` | match |
| c256 | same, router `--balance-abs-threshold 32` | MegaMoE command | same | match |
| c384 | same, interval 20, decode MTPR 1024, fixed-slot cap 2047 | MegaMoE command + c384 adjustment | same | match |

`main` already matched the rest, including every #4315 delta from #45070: `SGLANG_HIP_DSV4_C4_INDEXER_ROWGROUP=1`, DP chunked prefill 131072, FlyDSL MTPR 16384, decode MTPR 512 / fixed-slot cap 1023 (1024 / 2047 at c384), `SGLANG_EPLB_P2P_BATCH_CHUNK_SIZE=7`, and the MegaMoE interval of 40 (20 at c384).

Recipe fields with no cookbook flag because SGLang `main` resolves them identically:

- `--speculative-num-steps 1 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 7`: `_handle_dspark` sets steps 1, top-k 1 and draft tokens to `--speculative-dspark-block-size` + 1.
- `--data-parallel-size 8 --enable-dp-attention`: `_handle_deprecated_dp_attention` resolves it to `--attn-dp-size 8`.
- `--served-model-name`: equals the `--model-path` default.

Benchmark-only controls such as synthetic acceptance and AIPerf orchestration were intentionally excluded:

- Benchmark env: `AIPERF_*`, `CONC`, `KV_OFFLOADING`, `AGENTIC_WARMUP_GRACE_PERIOD`. `AIPERF_HTTP_X_SMG_ROUTING_KEY_FROM_CORRELATION_ID` sets `X-SMG-Routing-Key`, which only the `consistent_hashing` and `manual` router policies read, not `cache_aware`.
- `SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=900`: Uvicorn's idle keep-alive; the recipe sets it to outlast AIPerf's pooled connections.
- `PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1`: container hygiene.
- `--enable-metrics`: server metrics that AIPerf scrapes (`AIPERF_REQUIRED_SERVER_METRIC_PREFIX`).
- Router: `--request-id-headers x-correlation-id` (AIPerf's tracing header), `--connect-timeout-secs 900` and `--request-timeout-secs 14400` (sized for the warmup drain), `--disable-health-check` and `--disable-retries` (measurement integrity).
- Synthetic acceptance and golden-AL injection come from the harness, not the recipe.

Image: `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261019` is active in the public `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm` repository (amd64 digest `sha256:8cb29fc407c2e46bdb1866c5edb91f109ac1acbbcb6905089beaa6c79b0813a2`, pushed 2026-10-19). Its image config shows a build from SGLang `main` with AITER `2bb549102ba2` and MORI `f39fa765e897`. It sets `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=1`, which the recipe overrides, and does not set `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES`.

Left unchanged: the Install example and `dockerImages.mi355x` / `mi300x` stay on `-20261016`, because they serve Deploy-panel cells that #4315 did not rerun; §3.6 names `-20261019` itself. #45090 removes the retired `SGLANG_ENABLE_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE=1` lines from these commands, and the new variables sit at the end of each block so the two PRs touch separate lines.

## Validation

- `git diff --check`: pass
- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` and `node --test docs/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs`: pass (38/38)
- `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` (mint 4.2.559, the CI pin): pass
- `mint validate`: fails on `main` and on this branch with the same pre-existing error, the stray `},` at line 100 of `docs/src/snippets/configs/popular-models.jsx` (also noted in #45111). With that line removed in a scratch copy that is not part of this PR, it passes.
- `SKIP=no-commit-to-branch pre-commit run --files docs/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4.mdx`: pass (codespell, whitespace, end-of-file, merge-conflict, private-key). `--all-files` was not run locally.
- `bash -n` on the four §3.6 command blocks: pass, with no duplicate variable or flag in any block.
- A script resolved the nine #4315 arms and compared their server flags, environment and router flags with §3.6 plus its adjustment rules: 55 gaps on `main`, 0 on this branch.
- Local rendered-page review (`mint dev`): pass. §3.6 renders, the four code blocks' rendered text is byte-identical to the source, and the page shows no client errors.

## Accuracy Tests

None. Documentation only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

None. No serving or benchmark runs were performed for this PR; the numbers live in the linked InferenceX run.

## Scope

- Documentation only: §3.6 of `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4.mdx`. No SGLang runtime code, config snippets, other hardware or other DeepSeek-V4 variants changed.

---

 | HiCache | off | on | on | on |
 | `--mem-fraction-static` | 0.86 | 0.86 | 0.92 | 0.85 |
 
+The commands follow the [submitted recipe at `fd09dd949a18`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/fd09dd949a18ef2f3ff2912411d980b3f6b810a1/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/dsv4/sglang/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml) ([InferenceX #4315](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4315)), with benchmark harness settings removed. Run them in `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261019`, the image that submission pins.
+
 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 bundles the DSpark head, so `--speculative-draft-model-path` is not needed. `--speculative-dspark-block-size 6` is the AL-optimal draft length on the committed golden curve (verify window 7). Keep `SGLANG_DSV4_UNIFIED_KV_FP8=1` on every command. The first three use `--enforce-shared-experts-fusion`; the MegaMoE command uses `--disable-shared-experts-fusion` instead.
 
-Four adjustments are not in the commands below. Add them when they apply:
+Every command sets `SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING=1` and `SGLANG_DSV4_REASONING_EFFORT=high`, so a request that sets neither `chat_template_kwargs.thinking` nor `reasoning_effort` runs in thinking mode at high effort, which is how AgentX measures this recipe. A request can still override either. `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=0` overrides the image's `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=1`. `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES` (HIP default 4) is 2 on the TP8 command and 5 on both DP8 commands.
+
+Five adjustments are not in the commands below. Add them when they apply:
 
+- `--max-running-requests` at twice the concurrency, and `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode` at the same value capped at 128. At concurrency 48 both are `96`; at 384 they are `768` and `128`.
 - `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable` at concurrency 1–4.
 - `--enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy interleave --enable-cp-decode-attn-tp` on the TP-only commands at concurrency 16 and above. Prefill context parallelism splits each prompt across all eight ranks (CP size = TP size).
 - `SGLANG_DSV4_GROUPED_ASM=1` on the TP-only commands at concurrency 16 and above — the kernel needs at least 16 requests per draft token.
